Proof of Work

How I actually work

Practice projects built against fictional brands, to show the process end-to-end — not screenshots from paid client accounts.

Practice Project

30-Day Content Calendar

Fictional brand: Verdant & Co. — sustainable kitchen goods e-commerce
Context

A new e-commerce brand needed a full month of content planned across social and email before its next product launch.

Task

Mapped 30 days of content across Instagram, Facebook, and Email, rotating five content pillars — product education, behind-the-scenes, customer proof, sustainability story, and promotion.

Output

A working calendar with platform, format, hook, and CTA specified for every day, ready to hand to a scheduling tool.

Practice Project

Search Ads Account Build

Fictional brand: Bright & Co. — home goods e-commerce
Context

A simulated brand launch needed a Google Ads account built from zero ahead of a paid search push.

Task

Ran keyword research, structured three campaigns by product category, set an initial bid strategy, and mapped conversion actions.

Output

A documented campaign structure with conversion tracking mapped, plus a sample monthly performance report layout.

Practice Project

GA4 & GTM Tracking Build

Fictional brand: Northside Studio — local service business
Context

A simulated local business had no reliable way to see which pages and forms actually drove leads.

Task

Set up a GTM container, configured GA4 events and conversions, and reviewed Search Console for indexing gaps.

Output

A working tag map, a defined GA4 event list, and a one-page dashboard template for weekly checks.
